answer: Make sponsors liable for whoever they vouch in. Each new account needs a sponsor at least 20 epochs old. The sponsor locks 100 tokens per invitee for 30 epochs and can vouch for at most 2 accounts per epoch. If an invitee is flagged, the sponsor loses that stake and its own weight halves. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 500 sponsor-epochs and puts 100,000 tokens at risk, and one exposed raven among them punishes the sponsor too. No cipher hides who vouched for whom: every link stays on the ledger like tracks on a dune.
